substitution_attempted: No attempt was made. The engagement letter names the individual and the client requires that person to attend each shift.
decides_what_work_and_what_order: The depot supervisor allocates tasks at the start of each shift and reassigns the worker between stations during the day.
decides_how_work_performed: The worker follows the client's written operating procedures and is corrected on the spot where the method departs from them.
hours_and_location_set: Shifts are 07:00 to 15:30 on a rota published by the client, worked entirely at the client's warehouse.
report_to_a_manager: The worker reports to the shift supervisor, signs in on the depot system, and reports absence to that supervisor before the shift begins.
defective_work_corrected: Errors are corrected during paid hours at the client's cost. The worker bears no expense for remedial work.
loss_on_engagement: There is no realistic prospect of a loss. The worker is paid hourly and supplies nothing beyond personal safety boots.
presented_as_part_of_organisation: The worker wears the client's branded uniform, holds a staff access badge, and is introduced to visiting drivers as a member of the depot team.
staff_benefits_training_management: The worker completes the client's induction and manual-handling training, attends daily briefings, and is supervised continuously.
practical_bar: The full-time rota leaves no practical capacity for other work, and the contract requires written consent before accepting any.

substitution_attempted: The contractor sent a qualified colleague for three weeks while working on another project. The client was notified afterwards and raised no objection. The contractor paid the colleague directly.
decides_what_work_and_what_order: The contractor agrees an outcome and a deadline, then plans the survey, procurement and installation stages without reference to the client.
decides_how_work_performed: The contractor selects the technical method, materials and sequence, subject only to statutory standards and the agreed specification.
hours_and_location_set: There are no set hours. The contractor attends the properties in the work order at times arranged directly with occupants.
report_to_a_manager: There is no manager or reporting line. The contractor issues completion certificates and raises technical queries when needed.
defective_work_corrected: The contractor returns at their own expense to remedy defects under a twelve-month warranty. Faults in client-supplied materials are chargeable.
loss_on_engagement: The fixed price carries a real risk of loss if materials, travel or remedial visits exceed the estimate. The contractor also funds vehicle and tool costs.
presented_as_part_of_organisation: The contractor trades as North Quay Field Services, issues its own invoices and business cards, and is described in client records as an external supplier.
staff_benefits_training_management: No benefits, training or supervision are provided. The contractor maintains its own certifications and engages its own assistants.
practical_bar: The contractor works for several housing associations concurrently and the agreement expressly permits other contracts.

substitution_attempted: The worker asked to send an assistant for one week in March. The client declined without giving a reason and the worker attended personally. The clause has not been used since.
decides_what_work_and_what_order: The client issues a weekly assignment list and sets the order where deadlines collide. The worker arranges the detailed sequence of interviews and desk research.
decides_how_work_performed: The worker selects the research method and drafts independently, though the client's project lead reviews methodology at checkpoints and can require changes to the reporting format.
hours_and_location_set: The agreement states a target of 24 hours per week, chosen by the worker within agreed availability windows. Most work is remote with one client-site meeting each fortnight.
report_to_a_manager: The worker reports deliverables to a project lead and attends fortnightly reviews. There is no disciplinary chain, though missed deadlines escalate to the account director.
defective_work_corrected: The worker revises reports containing avoidable errors at no extra charge. Revisions caused by a changed brief are quoted separately.
loss_on_engagement: Payment is partly by milestone, so extensive rework reduces the return on the worker's time. Business costs are modest and no specialist equipment is required.
presented_as_part_of_organisation: The worker appears on project materials as an external research consultant and keeps a separate email signature, but has access to the client's collaboration platform and is listed in its project directory.
staff_benefits_training_management: The client provides a systems induction and reviews deliverables. No employee benefits are given and supervision is limited to project coordination.
practical_bar: Other engagements are permitted, though the weekly availability commitment limits overlapping deadlines. Two small projects for other clients were completed in the period.

substitution_attempted: A substitute was proposed during illness. The client required the replacement to hold the same clinical certification and to complete its safeguarding induction. No replacement was ultimately used.
decides_what_work_and_what_order: The care coordinator sets the visit schedule and prioritises tasks according to each service user's care plan.
decides_how_work_performed: The worker follows the care plan and safeguarding procedures, exercising judgment only over routine household support.
hours_and_location_set: Visit times and addresses are fixed on the rota, including alternate weekends. Travel between visits is the worker's own arrangement.
report_to_a_manager: The worker reports to a care supervisor, logs every visit on the client's system, and attends review calls when requested.
defective_work_corrected: Where care is missed the agency arranges a replacement visit and absorbs the cost. The worker is not charged for that support.
loss_on_engagement: There is limited opportunity for loss. Payment is per visit and the worker supplies only minor personal items, though unpaid travel time is significant.
presented_as_part_of_organisation: The worker wears an agency identification badge and is introduced to families as an agency care worker rather than as an independent provider.
staff_benefits_training_management: Mandatory safeguarding training and regular supervision are provided. The worker does not receive the agency's full employee benefits package.
practical_bar: The rota leaves some free days, but fixed visits and travel between them make regular additional work difficult.

substitution_attempted: The consultant delegated part of the data analysis to a junior associate without seeking approval. The client accepted the final report from the consultant as the contracting party.
decides_what_work_and_what_order: The consultant agreed the objective with the sponsor and independently planned the research stages and their order.
decides_how_work_performed: The consultant selects the methodology, interview format and analysis tools without client direction.
hours_and_location_set: There are no set hours or required workplace. Interviews are booked around participant availability and workshop dates are fixed by agreement.
report_to_a_manager: The consultant reports on milestones to a programme sponsor and is not managed day to day.
defective_work_corrected: Work falling outside the agreed scope is amended without further payment. Any associate's rework is funded from the project fee.
loss_on_engagement: The consultant bears the risk of lost time and can make a substantial loss if recruitment or research costs exceed the quote.
presented_as_part_of_organisation: The consultant uses a separate company identity and is described in documents as an external adviser, although the client's logo appears on workshop slides.
staff_benefits_training_management: No benefits or internal training are offered beyond a one-hour briefing on internal terminology and policies.
practical_bar: The consultant accepts other work and has reserved only the agreed milestone dates for this project.
